verdict.rationale: CSC is an entity-management and registered-agent SaaS with a web presence and APIs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The direct probe returned HTTP 404 for llms.txt, and no evidence shows any agent-oriented documentation. The API mentions (csc-docs-5, csc-docs-16) are not agent-oriented docs and do not count toward this story.
